headline: Expedient Acquires phoenixNAP's U.S. Managed VMware Cloud Business
summary: Expedient has acquired phoenixNAP's U.S. managed VMware cloud business, expanding its VMware Cloud Foundation footprint while ensuring clients retain their environments and service levels.
why: Corporate acquisitions in the cloud service sector allow providers to scale infrastructure and expand geographic or technological footprints.

impacts.name: Expedient
impacts.why: Expedient expands its cloud footprint through the acquisition.
